title: Free Money Spreadsheets
description: 24 free money spreadsheets for Google Sheets and Excel: budget planners, debt trackers, savings challenges and calculators, built for small incomes.
body:
Free budget planners, debt trackers, savings challenges and simple calculators, built for beginners and small incomes. Every sheet works in Google Sheets and Excel. There is no sign-up and no email needed.

Download all 24 spreadsheets (.zip)

Prefer just one? Every spreadsheet is listed below with its own download and a step-by-step guide. ## How to use them 1. Download a file and open it in Excel, or upload it to Google Drive and open it with Google Sheets. 2. Start with the **Start here** tab. It explains the sheet in a few short steps. 3. Type in the **yellow cells** only. White cells calculate by themselves. 4. Replace the example numbers with your own. They are only there to show the format. ## Budgeting **Monthly budget template.** Income, a plan for each category, and what is left, with a transactions log. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-budget-template.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/free-budget-template-google-sheets/) **Expense tracker.** Log purchases and see each month's totals by category. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-expense-tracker.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/track-expenses-google-sheets/) **Spending audit worksheet.** Compare what you think you spend with three months of real numbers. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-spending-audit-worksheet.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/spending-audit/) **Bill tracker.** Days left until each bill is due, plus a paid checklist. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-bill-tracker.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/bill-tracker-template/) **Biweekly paycheck budget.** Which bills each paycheck must cover, for the next 26 paydays. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-biweekly-paycheck-budget.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/biweekly-budget-template/) **Half payment bill splitter.** Halve every bill and set the same amount aside each payday. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-half-payment-bill-splitter.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/half-payment-method/) **Bill triage worksheet.** For tight months: which bills to pay first and which to call about. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-bill-triage-worksheet.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/cant-pay-my-bills/) **Semester budget planner.** Turn a term's money into a weekly allowance that lasts. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-semester-budget-planner.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/budget-as-a-student/) **Rent affordability worksheet.** Your real rent ceiling from take-home pay, plus a roommate split. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-rent-affordability-worksheet.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/how-much-rent-can-i-afford/) **Couples bill split calculator.** Half and half versus a split by income, side by side. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-couples-bill-split-calculator.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/how-couples-split-bills/) **SUMIF and SUMIFS practice workbook.** Seven budgeting formulas to learn and practise. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-sumifs-practice.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/sumifs-google-sheets/) ## Saving **Savings goal tracker.** A monthly amount and a progress bar for each goal. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-savings-goal-tracker.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/savings-goal-tracker/) **Sinking funds planner.** How much to set aside each month for costs you know are coming. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-sinking-funds.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/sinking-funds-spreadsheet/) **Emergency fund calculator.** Four targets and the month you will reach each one. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-emergency-fund-calculator.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/emergency-fund-calculator/) **52-week savings challenge tracker.** Classic, reverse, flat, half and bingo versions. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-52-week-savings-challenge.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/52-week-savings-challenge/) **No-spend challenge tracker.** Mark each clean day and count the money you kept. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-no-spend-challenge-tracker.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/no-spend-challenge/) **Compound growth calculator.** See what starting early is worth. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-compound-growth-calculator.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/compound-interest-explained-simply/) **Net worth tracker.** What you own minus what you owe, tracked over time. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-net-worth-tracker.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/how-to-calculate-net-worth/) ## Debt and credit **Debt snowball and avalanche planner.** Your payoff order, debt-free date and total interest. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-debt-snowball-spreadsheet.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/debt-snowball-spreadsheet/) **Minimum payment planner.** What paying only the minimum really costs, and how to beat it. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-minimum-payment-planner.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/minimum-payment-trap/) **Debt consolidation comparison.** Stay on the card, transfer the balance, or take a loan. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-debt-consolidation-comparison.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/debt-consolidation-vs-balance-transfer/) **Buy now, pay later tracker.** Every BNPL plan in one list, with what is due next. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-bnpl-payment-tracker.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/buy-now-pay-later-credit-score/) **Credit report dispute tracker.** Dates, evidence and replies for every dispute. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-credit-report-dispute-tracker.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/dispute-credit-report-error/) ## Earning and tax **Gig income and tax tracker (US).** Log payouts and miles, and see a rough tax set-aside for each IRS period. [Download (.xlsx)](/assets/files/guidelark-gig-income-tax-tracker.xlsx) · [Read the guide](/blog/gig-worker-taxes/) ## Common questions **Are they really free?** Yes. Download them, change them and share them with anyone. **Do they work on a phone?** Yes. Open them in the Google Sheets or Excel app. **Do they connect to my bank?** No. You type your own numbers, and nobody else sees them. The files live on your device or in your own Google Drive. *These spreadsheets are general information, not financial advice.*
